faq.a: Zyberlane is a creative technology company developing original software, immersive experiences, interactive digital art and experimental technology. We also collaborate with clients on websites, branding, content and digital systems.

faq.q: How do I get a quotation?
faq.a: Tell us about your business, what you need and any requirements. Email contact@zyberlane.com so we can review the scope and provide a quotation.
Zyberlane is based in Sri Lanka and works remotely with businesses worldwide.

faq.q: Do I need a complete brief?
faq.a: Share your goals and requirements. We can discuss what fits and define a realistic scope.

faq.q: How much does a project cost?
faq.a: Pricing depends on scope, functionality, design requirements and complexity. A quotation follows review.

For client collaborations, we scope Web Design & Development, Branding & Creative, Digital Marketing, Social Media & Content, Search & AI Visibility, and AI & Business Automation. Original XR and creative technology projects are developed separately.

faq.q: Can you add e-commerce or booking?
faq.a: Yes, depending on requirements and feasibility. Complex systems receive a custom quotation.

faq.q: Can you create an interactive experience?
faq.a: Yes. We explore interactive web experiences, XR software, real-time visuals and creative coding. Client requests are reviewed for feasibility, scope, device compatibility and testing before commitments are made.
Yes. We develop original software experiments and take on suitable client web applications and custom digital tools, with requirements and feasibility agreed before development.
We discuss goals, users, requirements and constraints before agreeing the work.
We can assess the current site and discuss whether improving it or rebuilding parts makes sense.
Yes. Scope, communication, payment arrangements and requirements are agreed before work begins.
Discover the requirements, plan and design, develop and review, then test and arrange the agreed handover.
Maintenance and support options are available. Significant new functionality may need a separate quotation.
Founder Zyberlane coordinates project direction and communication, with project-based support around the agreed work.
Zyberlane is a founder-led creative technology company based in Sri Lanka, creating original software and interactive experiences while collaborating with clients worldwide.

create.title: Digital experiences built around your business.
cta: Tell us what you're trying to achieve.
We'll help you figure out what needs to be built.

steps.name: Understand
steps.body: Before we design anything, we learn about your business.
steps.end: A clear understanding of what we're building and why.

steps.name: Define
steps.body: We turn everything we've learned into a clear plan.

steps.name: Explore
steps.body: We explore ideas, layouts, references and visual directions.

steps.name: Design
steps.sub: The idea starts to take shape.

steps.name: Refine
steps.end: We refine until everything feels right.

steps.name: Build
steps.body: Once the direction is approved, we bring the experience to life.
steps.end: We develop the website, integrate the required functionality and make it responsive across devices.

steps.name: Test
steps.sub: Before people use it, we test it.

steps.name: Launch
steps.body: Once everything is tested and approved, we launch.
steps.end: Your idea becomes a real digital experience.

steps.name: Evolve
steps.body: Businesses change. Your website should be able to change with them.
steps.end: We can continue supporting, improving and evolving your digital experience as your business grows.
